methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $30M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy. Range: $700M - $3.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Ideon Technologies is a Series B climate and energy company that has raised $30M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company (Lnza) operating in the same sector at similar or adjacent funding stages, including peers such as KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $30M total raised as a proxy base, yielding $57M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $700M to $3.0B; the median valuation across this set is $1.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneous capital intensity and commercialization timelines within frontier energy technologies.

The triangulated range is $48M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median implied valuation of $528M. The stage-progression method produces a more conservative signal, while peer multiples drive toward the high end of the range. Key uncertainties include the maturity of Ideon's underlying technology, capital requirements to reach commercialization, and the sustainability of current market sentiment toward climate-tech venture funding. The 23x spread between low and high reflects genuine uncertainty about appropriate comparability and stage-adjusted discount rates for pre-revenue frontier companies.
